facts.text: The Dunlin is at 6000 Kiawah River Drive, Johns Island, South Carolina, about 20 miles and a 40 minute drive from downtown Charleston.
facts.excerpt: The Dunlin is located at 6000 Kiawah River Drive, Johns Island, South Carolina 29455, about 20 miles and a 40 minute drive from downtown Charleston.

facts.text: The Dunlin is named after a local shorebird.
facts.excerpt: named after our beautiful local shorebird

facts.text: The interiors are by Amanda Lindroth Design.
facts.excerpt: Interiors are by Amanda Lindroth Design

facts.text: The architect was Robert Glazier, with a focus on Sea Island architecture.
facts.excerpt: designed by architect Robert Glazier (also of Rosewood, Montage, and Four Seasons properties across the globe) with a focus on Sea Island architecture

facts.text: Rooms have a cottage-inspired look with white-washed walls, honey oak floors, mint green accents and textural linen fabrics.
facts.excerpt: a cottage-inspired aesthetic, featuring white-washed rooms and honey oak floors with mint green accents and textural linen fabrics

facts.text: Generous porches offer riverfront views over the marshlands.
facts.excerpt: generous porches are the perfect place for morning coffee or a nightcap, offering a sublime oasis in the marshlands with expansive riverfront views

facts.text: The suites have outdoor soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: we’re partial to the outdoor soaking tubs, ideal for relaxing under the stars after a day spent exploring the marsh

facts.text: The Riverfront Bungalows have kitchenettes, furnished porches and fenced-in yards.
facts.excerpt: Fully-equipped kitchenettes, graciously furnished porches, fenced-in yards and sweeping riverfront panoramas transform each Bungalow into a private haven

facts.text: Linnette's is the signature restaurant, with a seafood-forward menu and wood-fired dishes cooked in an open kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Linnette’s, the signature restaurant, pays homage to the heritage of Johns Island

facts.text: Linnette's menu is seafood-forward, built around the catch of the day from local fishermen.
facts.excerpt: imagine a seafood-forward menu spotlighting the catch of the day from our local fishermen and produce that changes with the seasons

facts.text: The Cove is a riverfront pool club with a heated pool, hot tub, poolside dining and cabanas.
facts.excerpt: The Dunlin has The Cove, a riverfront pool club featuring a heated pool, hot tub, poolside dining and cabanas.

facts.text: Activities include kayaking, paddleboarding, fly fishing, boat excursions, biking, exploring the farm and birdwatching.
facts.excerpt: Guests can kayak, paddleboard, fly fish, take boat excursions, take an art class, play mahjong, bike, explore the farm, birdwatch

facts.text: The property has an onsite farm and waterfront hiking trails.
facts.excerpt: an onsite farm and 20 miles of waterfront hiking trails

facts.text: Epicurean Experiences include pop-up farm dinners and riverside oyster roasts.
facts.excerpt: pop-up farm dinners, riverside oyster roasts, and outdoor movie nights with Southern snacks and local beer

facts.text: Charleston International Airport is 30 miles and 45 minutes from The Dunlin.
facts.excerpt: Charleston International Airport is located 30 miles/45 minutes from The Dunlin.

facts.text: Traffic can be expected on the drive from downtown Charleston at commuting hours.
facts.excerpt: expect traffic on the drive from downtown Charleston if you’re setting out at commuting hours

facts.text: Walkways and paths on the property are paved and wheelchair accessible, as are the rooms and dining venues.
facts.excerpt: Walkways and paths on the property are paved and wheelchair accessible, as are the rooms and dining venues.

facts.text: Spa treatments use organic materials such as local honey.
facts.excerpt: Treatments at the central spa, too, flex the sustainability of the property, with organic materials like local honey taking center stage.

facts.text: Families are offered connecting rooms and suites and larger living and dining spaces.
facts.excerpt: The Dunlin welcomes families with connecting rooms and suites, larger living and dining spaces, farm experiences, outdoor adventures and family-oriented dining.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists The Dunlin in its Readers' Choice Awards 2025 and 2026.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2025, 2026

facts.text: Porch doors have sensors that halt the air conditioning whenever the room is not sealed.
facts.excerpt: Porch doors have sensors on them which halt the air conditioning inside any time the room isn’t sealed
